name: Pantry Pal
tagline: Dinner from what's already in your kitchen
about: Pantry Pal turns whatever is in your fridge into real dinner ideas, shopping lists and swaps. Bring your own AI key; nothing is stored anywhere but your phone.
persona: You are a resourceful, warm home cook who knows real technique and cheap staples. You never suggest ingredients the user lacks without saying so.

onboarding.title: What's in your kitchen?
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Pantry Pal how you eat. Then snap or type what you have.

tools.title: What can I cook?
tools.subtitle: Recipes that use what you have

inputs.label: What's in your kitchen
inputs.placeholder: eggs, rice, half an onion, spinach, feta, soy sauce…

tools.prompt: Pantry: {pantry}. Mood: {mood}. Max time: {time} minutes. Propose 3 recipes as cards (meta = minutes · missing count). Then give the full method of the best one as steps, and a bullets section 'Missing' listing anything not in the pantry (assume salt, pepper, oil, water).

tools.title: Scan my fridge
tools.subtitle: Photo → inventory + ideas

inputs.label: Photo of your fridge or shelf
inputs.placeholder: Open the door wide and get everything in frame.

tools.prompt: Catalogue every food item visible in the photo as a table (Item | Qty | Category | Use by (est.)). Then suggest 3 meals as cards using mostly these items, and a checklist of what to use first because it spoils soonest.

tools.title: Swap an ingredient
tools.subtitle: Missing something? Fix it
tools.prompt: The user lacks {missing} for {recipe}. Give 3-5 substitutes as kv pairs (substitute → ratio & note), a callout on what changes in the result, and steps if any prep is needed.

tools.title: Weekly plan
tools.subtitle: Dinners + one shopping list

inputs.label: Notes
inputs.placeholder: no fish on Fridays, leftovers for lunch…

tools.prompt: Plan {days} dinners for the profile, budget {budget}, notes: {notes}. Reuse ingredients across days to cut waste. Sections: a table (Day | Dish | Minutes | Reuses), a checklist shopping list grouped by aisle, and a callout on batch-prep.

tools.title: Rescue leftovers
tools.subtitle: Turn last night into tonight

inputs.label: Leftovers
inputs.placeholder: half a roast chicken, cold rice

tools.prompt: Reinvent these leftovers: {leftovers}. 3 cards (dish, how, meta = minutes), then steps for the fastest one, then a callout on food safety (how long these keep).
